english.note: Use this when stressing that the addressee, rather than anyone else, is involved.

exampleSentences.english: You go ask him yourself; I don't need to come with you.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你自己去問佢啦，唔使我陪你。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 zi6 gei2 heoi3 man6 keoi5 laa1 m4 sai2 ngo5 pui4 nei5
